source_card_updates.title: PEACE
bounded_findings: 200000 train, 8192 validation, 4096 test; 21 Faust effects; serial chains length 1-3; 10 s, 48 kHz; wet normalized to -18 LUFS.
Single-effect gallery 1024: BoxGraph R@1 16.8 and R@10 44.3; T5 18.1 and 45.2.
Ordered-pair benchmark: BoxGraph R@1 17.4 and R@10 61.4; T5 12.4 and 43.2; supervised classifier 21.4 and 65.9.
Compressor, gate, limiter and stereo-width single-effect R@1 are especially weak.
No listener study; OOD evaluation is limited to RIR/reverb.
limitations: Random parameters and source/preset pairings; source not guaranteed dry.
No exact parameter recovery or unknown-plugin validation.
Mid/side power features remove absolute loudness and preserve mirror-panning ambiguity.

source_card_updates.title: CTAG-FX
bounded_findings: Processor tone-shaping test bypassed A&R-CTAG and used GPT-4o configs on one 10 s guitar performance with 30 shared scrambled permutations per prompt.
28 of 1200 scrambled renders were excluded for nonfinite output.
A&R-versus-CTAG CLAP comparison is a separate synth-side evaluation, not end-to-end CTAG-FX validation.
RMS matching is not full BS.1770 loudness and true-peak matching.
Eight NAM captures report ESR 0.0003-0.0815, median 0.0140, without listener or arbitrary-setting generalization validation.
Official demo exposes a normalized 78-D configuration but states code is coming soon.
limitations: Demo RAW input already includes EQ, 1176, EQ73 and LA-2A processing.
Demo outputs are not loudness matched.
Processor mapping, stabilizer implementation, lockfile, license and executable source are unavailable.

artifact_audits.title: PEACE repository
findings: Package version 0.1.0; explicit Hugging Face revision supported but omitted in README example.
Weight loading validates keys/shapes, not artifact hash.
Tests use small random models and default render checks, not released-weight paper reproduction.
DawDreamer fixed at 0.9.0; most other dependencies use ranges.
Top-level MIT code coexists with CC-BY-NC-4.0 weights and mixed effect-source licenses including GPL/LGPL-derived code.

artifact_audits.title: CTAG-FX official demo
findings: RAW guitar provenance names Channel EQ, UA 1176, T-Racks EQ 73 and Teletronix LA-2A.
Page warns processed outputs are louder and not loudness matched.
Code release remains marked coming soon.

knowledge_cards.claim: Use PEACE arXiv v1 as the canonical numerical record where padding differs; camera-ready and arXiv are one evidence family.
The supervised classifier outperforms PEACE retrieval on the closed 420-pair benchmark; require a closed-set baseline.
BoxGraph R@10 61.4 implies 38.6 percent exact-chain omission even under the PEACE benchmark; top-K omission is not negative proof.
Pinned source code does not pin model bytes; source revision, model revision and file hashes are separate provenance gates.
Toy save/load and default renderer tests do not reproduce pretrained retrieval tables.
PEACE batch rendering needs external finite, peak, silence and stuck-output guards.
PEACE is license-composite; MIT code does not override CC-BY-NC weights or effect-source obligations.
CTAG-FX processor and A&R representation evaluations are separate and cannot be combined into end-to-end evidence.
The CTAG-FX demo RAW input is already processed and variants are not loudness matched, so it cannot support a controlled bypass A/B.
NAM ESR on eight fixed captures is not perceptual equivalence or arbitrary-setting generalization.
